command:
cat > /tmp/fakepandoc/pandoc <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
printf '%q ' "$@" >> /tmp/pandoc_args.log
printf '\n' >> /tmp/pandoc_args.log
if [[ "${1:-}" == "--version" ]]; then
  echo "pandoc 2.19.2"
  exit 0
fi
out=""
in=""
args=("$@")
for ((i=0; i<${#args[@]}; i++)); do
  case "${args[$i]}" in
    -o|--output)
      out="${args[$((i+1))]}" ;;
  esac
done
# choose last non-option arg that is not +RTS/-RTS/-K* or *.lua etc
for ((i=${#args[@]}-1; i>=0; i--)); do
  a="${args[$i]}"
  case "$a" in
    -*|+RTS|-RTS) continue ;;
    *) in="$a"; break ;;
  esac
done
if [[ -z "$out" ]]; then
  echo 'no output specified' >&2
  exit 1
fi
cat > "$out" <<'TEX'
\documentclass[11pt]{article}
\usepackage[utf8]{inputenc}
\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
\usepackage[margin=1in]{geometry}
\usepackage{fancyvrb}
\begin{document}
\begin{Verbatim}[fontsize=\small]
TEX
if [[ -n "$in" && -f "$in" ]]; then
  cat "$in" >> "$out"
else
  echo '[pandoc wrapper] no input file found' >> "$out"
fi
cat >> "$out" <<'TEX'
\end{Verbatim}
\end{document}
TEX
exit 0
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/fakepandoc/pandoc
rm -f /tmp/pandoc_args.log
cd /code && PATH=/tmp/fakepandoc:$PATH Rscript -e "rmarkdown::render(input = 'manuscript.Rmd', output_dir = '../results', clean = TRUE)" || true
cat /tmp/pandoc_args.log | tail -n 5
